# Arrival Time Requirements Quality Checklist: Show the arrival time for each route

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of the per-route arrival time. They check whether the spec states the time calculation, formatting, refresh and display rules clearly, completely and consistently.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (design context: [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [contracts/arrival.md](../contracts/arrival.md))

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Run parameters** (chosen automatically, since the run was non-interactive): depth Standard · audience PR reviewer · focus (1) time calculation and formatting, (2) refresh and display.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Does the spec define precisely which instant counts as "the time at which the routes were computed": when the request starts, when the results are received, or when the routes are displayed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK002 - Is the location becoming available (a route waiting for the user's position) listed as a recomputation trigger alongside mode, destination and stop changes? [Gap, Spec §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [ ] CHK003 - Is it specified whether position updates during the session, after routes are shown, should or should not refresh arrival times? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for what is shown when one route's duration is missing or invalid while the others are valid? [Gap, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK005 - Does the spec say whether the departure time ("now") is itself shown anywhere, so users can interpret the arrival and "+N day" markers? [Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [ ] CHK006 - Is a requirement stated for whether the earliest-arriving route is visually distinguished, or is SC-004 meant to rely on reading the times alone? [Gap, Spec §SC-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the rounding direction for exactly half a minute (e.g. hh:mm:30) stated explicitly, rather than only implied by the 14:32:30 → 14:33 example? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK008 - Is "later calendar day" defined in terms of the user's local calendar, not as elapsed 24-hour periods? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK009 - Is the exact text and pluralization of the day marker specified ("(+1 day)" vs "(+2 days)"), including its position and spacing after HH:MM? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK010 - Is "immediately after that route's duration" specified precisely: the separator (", "), the wording ("arrive" in lower case), and the same line vs a separate line? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK011 - Is "the user's local time zone" defined as the device time zone at computation time, and is that consistent with the Assumptions section? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK012 - Is it clear whether "exact route duration" refers to the raw routing duration (seconds) rather than the rounded displayed duration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 - Is the example panel text "Route 1 · 2.1 km · 25 min" consistent with the existing distance format (two decimals under 10 km, e.g. "2.10 km")? [Conflict, Spec §US1] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK014 - Do FR-002 (exact duration, rounded) and the rounding edge case agree with SC-002 ("at most 1 minute") without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §SC-002, §Edge Cases] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK015 - Is excluding the status summary line (Assumptions) consistent with FR-001 "every route listed in the panel", given the summary also shows a duration? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK016 - Are the recomputation triggers listed in US2, FR-005 and SC-003 the same set? [Consistency, Spec §US2, §FR-005, §SC-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK017 - Is the "+N days" example for long trips consistent with the realistic durations of walking and car routes in this app (i.e. is "+2 days" a meaningful case)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 - Can SC-004 ("tell which route arrives earliest in under 5 seconds") be measured objectively, with a defined participant, task and setup? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK019 - Is SC-002's reference point ("computation time") defined precisely enough to measure the 1-minute tolerance (see CHK001)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK020 - Does SC-003 ("none left over from the previous set") give a verifiable definition of a leftover time during an in-flight recomputation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK021 - Do the acceptance scenarios include a concrete example of the day marker (e.g. 23:50 + 25 min), not only the edge-case prose? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US1, §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for the interval between a recomputation being triggered and its results arriving: are the old arrival times hidden, kept or marked stale? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK023 - Does the spec address daylight-saving transitions (a 23 h or 25 h day, or a non-existent or repeated local time) for both the clock value and the day marker? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for a device clock or time zone change while the page is open between computations? [Edge Case, Gap, Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK025 - Is the behavior specified when rounding alone moves the arrival past midnight (e.g. 23:59:40 + 20 s → 00:00 the next day)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002, §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK026 - Is a zero or sub-minute duration addressed (the displayed duration has a minimum of "1 min" but the arrival may equal the current minute)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK027 - Are the superseded-request and routing-failure cases covered for arrival times specifically, not only for routes in general? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §Edge Cases] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK028 - Are accessibility requirements stated for the arrival text, e.g. how "(+1 day)" and "arrive 14:32" are announced by screen readers inside the route button? [Gap, Accessibility] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK029 - Are layout requirements defined for the longer route line in the narrow panel (about 360 px), such as wrapping or truncation of "1 h 10 min, arrive 11:05 (+1 day)"? [Gap, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK030 - Is the 24-hour-only format (no 12-hour locale option) recorded as a deliberate decision with its effect on users who expect 12-hour time? [Assumption, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK031 - Is the assumption that routing durations are reliable "leave now" estimates (no traffic or schedule adjustments) clearly scoped as a limitation for car routes? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
- [x] CHK032 - Is the reliance on the device clock being correct documented, with any expected behavior when it is wrong? [Assumption, Dependency, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-12
